title: Bundled Toddler in Winter Scarf by Brick Wall, 1948 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid full-length outdoor portrait of a young child warmly bundled for cold weather in a dark coat, mittens, and a wrapped scarf. The child stands in a grassy yard against a rustic brick wall, casting a sharp shadow in the late winter sunlight. The image captures a timeless slice of post-WWII domestic childhood.
